_comment: Meal-plan acceptability corpus. Each case gives a pantry (Ingredient rows with
label nutrition), the ordered meal responses the generation call site returns
(the last one repeats if the retry loop asks for more), and the outcome a
reviewer labelled. Calories are NOT mocked: the harness runs the real
clamp -> scale -> calculate_meal_macros path, so a meal is acceptable only
when the pipeline's own estimate lands in MEAL_CALORIE_MIN..MAX, the schema is
valid, instructions are present, and every ingredient used exists in the pantry.
